about: The 1.8.9 movement oracle's EDGE world without its slime strip (slime is a 1.8 block): stone floor (top y = 64) over chunk columns -1..1 (x, z in [-16, 31]); strip I x -15..-10 (ice z -10..3, packed ice 4..15, soul sand over ice 22..25); strip W x -8..-6 (soul sand z -8..-5, a two-high web 0..1, a web over soul sand 2..4); strip L x -2..2 (a 3-deep pool z -12..-2, a 1-deep channel: source z = 2, levels 1..7 at z 3..9, a lava pool z 14..16); strip S x 4..8 (slab and stair steps z -6..0, a staircase to y = 67 at z 8..13, carpet z 18, snow z 20); strip F x 12..18 (fence row with a gate z = -8, wall row z = -2, panes and iron bars z = 4); strip C (a wall at z = -6 with a ladder at x = 21 and vines at x = 23); a platform x 20..27, z 8..14, top y = 67, with a slab rim at z = 14 and a stair column at x = 27; a step strip at z 26 (bottom slab x = 10, bed x = 12, slab under a top-slab ceiling x = 14, slab under a full-block ceiling x = 17); a 3-deep pool at x, z in [24, 30].
